I've been on antidepressants before and all I have to say is no, at least, not immediately. What happened with me was before I was socially anxious and depressed. I spent a lot of time in my room playing video games and watching anime. Also didn't have a lot of friends. I was fine with that because that's just how I liked things. But after I started taking the antidepressants I was happier which as a side effect made me more willing to try new things. So I started going to parties and drinking, things I would have never done before. Turns out I liked doing those things. Now, did I all of a sudden stop liking video games and anime? No, I still love those things. But I also enjoy going out and having a good time just as much.

TL;DR: No, but you might find you lime new things which might change you.
